ann.t: Pursuant to Regulation 33(3)(a) and (c)  of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we are submitting herewith the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30.09.2026 along with the Limited Review Report  and Declaration duly approved by the B

The Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter / Half Year ended 30.09.2026 along with the Limited Review Report for the Period 30.09.2026 at their Meeting held on 11.11.2026. The Board commenced at 11.55 A.M. and concluded at 13.05 P.M.
